verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies that Justworks PEO provides health insurance: customers terminate their prior health insurance provider on joining (docs-4), and Justworks provides customized quotes for the plans and pricing available through the PEO (docs-8, docs-34). Nothing documents how ops administers employee benefits enrollment or how premium deductions flow into payroll. Missing for 10: employee benefits enrollment workflow, plan administration tooling, documented sync of benefit deductions to payroll, independent corroboration.
